tools.name: get_voice_details
tools.description: Get full metadata for one voice token: persona, use case, accent, pitch, styles, preview audio and credit cost.

tools.name: list_my_custom_voices
tools.description: List the user's personal voices created with Voice Design (from a text prompt) or Voice Clone (from an audio sample), plus the remaining custom-voice quota. Use `voice` from the result in any speech tool.

tools.name: list_favorite_voices
tools.description: List the voices the user marked as favorites, in their saved order. Check this first when the user did not name a voice.

tools.name: add_favorite_voice
tools.description: Save a voice to the user's favorites (only when the user asks).

tools.name: remove_favorite_voice
tools.description: Remove a voice from the user's favorites (only when the user asks).

tools.name: design_custom_voice
tools.description: Create a new personal AI voice from a natural-language description (Gemini Voice Design). Uses one slot of the user's custom-voice quota - confirm with the user first. Good for a unique narrator or a character voice in a video/podcast. Returns the new `voice` token.

tools.name: get_account_status
tools.description: Show the user's plan tier, remaining characters/credits, max characters per request, max blocks per multi-voice/SRT job and API rate limits. Call before large jobs.

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: Convert one text into one MP3 with one voice. Use for narration, voiceover scripts, articles, lessons, announcements or any audio whose length can follow the speech. Consumes credits (characters x voice rate). Returns job_id, status and audio_url when ready.

tools.name: multi_voice_to_speech
tools.description: Render ordered segments, each with its own voice, into ONE merged MP3. Use for podcasts, dialogues, interviews, audio dramas or explainer videos with several speakers when there are no fixed timestamps. Consumes credits.

tools.name: srt_to_speech
tools.description: Create ONE MP3 that follows a subtitle timeline: every cue starts at its timestamp and speech speed auto-fits the cue duration. tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Check a speech job created earlier. Returns status (PENDING | SUCCESS | ERROR) and audio_url once SUCCESS. Never guess or fetch an audio URL before SUCCESS.

tools.name: list_recent_jobs
tools.description: List the user's most recent speech jobs with status and audio URLs, to reuse earlier audio instead of paying again.

tools.name: get_job_detail
tools.description: Get a multi_voice_to_speech or srt_to_speech job with every segment: text, voice and its own audio_url, plus the merged audio. Use it to build captions or a Remotion/NLE timeline (one <Sequence> per segment; measure each file's duration in the renderer).

tools.name: create_upload_url
tools.description: Get a one-time URL to upload a local video or audio file (mp4, mov, webm, mkv, mp3, wav, m4a...) up to 2 GB. tools.description: Speech-to-text for an uploaded video or audio file: returns timestamped SRT (the timeline to rewrite, translate or re-voice with srt_to_speech). Credits are charged per second of media, measured by the server. Use language = the spoken language code from list_languages.

tools.name: get_transcription
tools.description: Check a transcribe_media job and get its SRT once finished.

tools.name: estimate_video_localization
tools.description: Estimate the credits to dub one video into one or more languages (speech-to-text + translation + voice + video merge) before running localize_video. Pass video_url (duration is measured) or duration_seconds.

tools.description: Full automatic dubbing of an uploaded video: transcribe once, translate, voice every target language with its own voice and render a dubbed video per language. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job_status, list_recent_jobs, create_upload_url · Private data: list_voices, get_voice_details, design_custom_voice, get_job_detail, create_upload_url, transcribe_media · Public sink: create_upload_url, localize_video · Destructive: remove_favorite_voice, create_upload_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job_status, list_recent_jobs, create_upload_url · Private data: list_voices, get_voice_details, design_custom_voice, get_job_detail, create_upload_url, transcribe_media · Public sink: create_upload_url, localize_video · Destructive: remove_favorite_voice, create_upload_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
